title: Day After an Event
summary: Of the sessions whose PREVIOUS trading session was an event day in the named calendar, how often the session closed above its open. Adjacency is trading-calendar aware, so weekends and holidays never miscount which session came after the event. The default calendar is OPEX because it ships with the engine; any other named calendar reports zero matching sessions until its date file is present.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event calendar name as listed in the events data (e.g. OPEX, FOMC, CPI, NFP).

deltas: one parameterized preset covers the entire post-event family
holiday-aware adjacency instead of calendar-day arithmetic
open-to-close return distribution attached for the size of the after-move
